formula: Delete every original entity object iff exact(pmc_id,offset,length,text) is legally representable in at least one of the full17 GP windows and max(raw scores over every legal representation)<0. Keep unrepresented/uncovered spans and score exactly0. Reject full endpoint on NaN/Inf, duplicate/missing span or incomplete/inconsistent window evidence. Preserve remaining entity objects/order and every nonentity object. No additions/ID changes/patient-ID subsets/threshold search/new forwards.
parent_model: new BioClinicalModernBERT149M encoder plus original GP span head, original complete17 held windows
new_variable: New long-context GP state signal; zero is its fixed binary boundary, not a tuned veto threshold. Prior NO and9B veto negative and BOUNDARY control already exist.
zero_change: byteexact original prediction; inherit old metrics; gold0/v2=0
gate: strict Score>baseline; no automatic F0/originaldev/official extension
